name: Create or Update Contact
description: Creates a new contact or updates if the contact exists.

configurable_props.name: tenantId
configurable_props.label: Tenant ID
configurable_props.description: Select an organization tenant to use, or provide a tenant ID

configurable_props.name: name
configurable_props.label: Name
configurable_props.description: Full name of contact/organisation (max length = 255). The following is required to create a contact.

configurable_props.name: contactId
configurable_props.label: Contact ID
configurable_props.description: Unique identification of the contact

configurable_props.name: contactNumber
configurable_props.label: Contact Number
configurable_props.description: This can be updated via the API only i.e. This field is read only on the Xero contact screen, used to identify contacts in external systems (max length = 50). If the Contact Number is used, this is displayed as Contact Code in the Contacts UI in Xero.

configurable_props.name: accountNumber
configurable_props.label: Account Number
configurable_props.description: A user defined account number. This can be updated via the API and the [Xero UI](https://help.xero.com/ContactsAccountNumber) (max length = 50).

configurable_props.name: contactStatus
configurable_props.label: Contact Status
configurable_props.description: Current status of a contact - see contact status [types](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/types#ContactStatuses)

configurable_props.name: firstName
configurable_props.label: First Name
configurable_props.description: First name of contact person (max length = 255)

configurable_props.name: lastName
configurable_props.label: Last Name
configurable_props.description: Last name of contact person (max length = 255)

configurable_props.name: emailAddress
configurable_props.label: Email Address
configurable_props.description: Email address of contact person (umlauts not supported) (max length = 255)

configurable_props.name: skypeUserName
configurable_props.label: Skype User Name
configurable_props.description: Skype user name of contact

configurable_props.name: contactPersons
configurable_props.label: Contact Persons
configurable_props.description: See [contact persons](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/contacts#contact-persons)

configurable_props.name: bankAccountDetails
configurable_props.label: Bank Account Details
configurable_props.description: Bank account number of contact

configurable_props.name: taxNumber
configurable_props.label: Tax Number
configurable_props.description: Tax number of contact - this is also known as the ABN (Australia), GST Number (New Zealand), VAT Number (UK) or Tax ID Number (US and global) in the Xero UI depending on which regionalized version of Xero you are using (max length = 50)

configurable_props.name: accountReceivableTaxType
configurable_props.label: Account Receivable Tax Type
configurable_props.description: Default tax type used for contact on AP invoices

configurable_props.name: accountPayableType
configurable_props.label: Account Payable Type
configurable_props.description: Store certain address types for a contact - see address types

configurable_props.name: addresses
configurable_props.label: Addresses
configurable_props.description: Store certain address types for a contact - see address types

configurable_props.name: phones
configurable_props.label: Phones
configurable_props.description: Store certain phone types for a contact - see phone types

configurable_props.name: isSupplier
configurable_props.label: Is Supplier
configurable_props.description: true or false  Boolean that describes if a contact that has any AP invoices entered against them. Cannot be set via PUT or POST - it is automatically set when an accounts payable invoice is generated against this contact.

configurable_props.name: isCustomer
configurable_props.label: Is Customer
configurable_props.description: true or false  Boolean that describes if a contact has any AR invoices entered against them. Cannot be set via PUT or POST - it is automatically set when an accounts receivable invoice is generated against this contact.

configurable_props.name: defaultCurrency
configurable_props.label: Default Currency
configurable_props.description: Default currency for raising invoices against contact

configurable_props.name: xeroNetworkKey
configurable_props.label: Xero Network Key
configurable_props.description: Store XeroNetworkKey for contacts

configurable_props.name: salesDefaultAccountCode
configurable_props.label: Sales Default Account Code
configurable_props.description: The default sales [account code](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/accounts) for contacts

configurable_props.name: puchasesDefaultAccountCode
configurable_props.label: Purchases Default Account Code
configurable_props.description: The default purchases [account code](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/accounts) for contacts

configurable_props.name: salesTrackingCategories
configurable_props.label: Sales Tracking Categories
configurable_props.description: The default sales [tracking categories](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/tracking-categories/) for contacts

configurable_props.name: puechasesTrackingCategories
configurable_props.label: Purchases Tracking Categories
configurable_props.description: The default purchases [tracking categories](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/tracking-categories/) for contacts

configurable_props.name: trackingCategoryName
configurable_props.label: Tracking Category Name
configurable_props.description: The name of the Tracking Category assigned to the contact under SalesTrackingCategories and PurchasesTrackingCategories

configurable_props.name: trackingOptionName
configurable_props.label: Tracking Option Name
configurable_props.description: The name of the Tracking Option assigned to the contact under SalesTrackingCategories and PurchasesTrackingCategories

configurable_props.name: paymentTermsBillDay
configurable_props.label: Payment Terms Bill Day
configurable_props.description: The default payment terms bill day

configurable_props.name: paymentTermsBillType
configurable_props.label: Payment Terms Bill Type
configurable_props.description: The default payment terms bill type
